feeds.name: Microsoft 365 Roadmap - Get the Latest Updates

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-Archive File Classification Behavior Change for Windows Endpoints
items.summary: We are updating archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints to align with cloud workloads. This change improves consistency, reduces noise in event reporting, and enhances performance when processing archive files.GA date: December CY2026Preview date: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Multi-line call history tabs in the Calls app
items.summary: Multi-line users get a redesigned call history experience that organizes activity by phone line. Call activity is organized into dedicated tabs for each line, so history, voicemails, and recordings appear under the line they belong to, making navigation and call management simpler and more intuitive.GA date: October CY2025

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Upgraded call history in Teams Calls app
items.summary: Call history in the Teams Calls app is being upgraded to make it easier to find and act on past call activity. Missed calls and associated voicemails will be consolidated into a single call history entry, reducing clutter and simplifying follow-up. Call history will also expand from 100 records to up to 3,000 records or 6 months of history, whichever limit is reached first, giving users more context when they need it.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Analytics for desk utilization on Teams Pro Management portal
items.summary: Teams admins can access utilization analytics for Teams bookable desks on Teams Pro Management portal, similar to analytics provided for meeting rooms on the portal today. For utilization analytics to be enabled, a desk needs to have one or more peripheral device associated, and the desk needs to be licensed with Teams Shared Space license or Teams Shared Space - Single Space license.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: SharePoint: Changes to the FAQ web part authoring experience
items.summary: The SharePoint FAQ web part will provide a standard, non-AI experience for manually creating, editing, and managing FAQs. The AI-assisted FAQ creation and import will move to the Copilot in SharePoint authoring experience, where authors can use natural-language prompts and selected grounding sources to generate FAQ content that is saved to the compatible FAQ web part. Existing FAQ web parts and their content will continue to render without migration.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Organize important resources in chats and channels
items.summary: Microsoft Teams is introducing a new way to organize and access important resources in chats and channels. Users will be able to pin key content, including links, files, and messages, directly beneath the chat or channel header for quick access. Resources can also be organized into folders, making it easier to keep important information visible and discoverable in active conversations. This update provides a more consistent experience across chats and channels, helping users stay organized, quic

items.title: Outlook: Inline chat for email drafting
items.summary: Instead of opening Copilot Chat every time you want to use Copilot to draft a message, this change introduces an inline chat component that streamlines the process and lets you interact with Copilot without opening the sidebar.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.summary: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent value insights in Agent 365 Dashboard
items.summary:
Customers can now view value insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics). These insights help business leaders and change and adoption specialists understand not only whether agents are being used, but also the estimated assisted hours agents provide and the types of work contributing to that value.
This update builds on the existing Agent 365 Dashboard adoption experience by connecting agent activity with a clearer view of the work agents support across th

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.summary: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.GA date: October CY2026Preview date: September CY2026

items.title: Microsoft 365: Teams Channel Backup
items.summary: A backup and recovery feature that lets you recover team & channel data (like files, messages exchanged over channels) in Microsoft Teams to a previously known good state after accidental changes or security compromises. Supported items include Team, Channels (Standard, Private, Public) and underlying data. Retention period supported is 30 days.GA date: December CY2026

items.title: OneDrive: Sync support for up to 1 million items on macOS
items.summary: OneDrive Sync supports syncing up to 1 million items on macOS devices, helping teams manage large document libraries and shared content at scale without compromising access across devices. This preview requires the Insiders ring and that devices meet minimum hardware and configuration requirements. Devices that don't meet these requirements continue to sync at the existing 300,000-item supported limit with no disruption.GA date: June CY2027Preview date: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Glint - Survey taking experience refinements
items.summary: This feature is a collection of improvements including updates to the auto-save experience for comments, simplifying survey navigation through buttons by consolidating the "Skip" and "Done" buttons into a single "Next" button, and to give the survey taker greater control over question progression by refining the auto-scroll behavior when updating answers to questions.GA date: September CY2026

items.title: Planner: Add times to task start, finish, and due dates
items.summary: Add specific times to task start, finish, and due dates. Define a plan’s time zone and working hours to automatically provide default task times and choose whether to view times in the plan’s time zone or your local time zone. This helps distributed teams coordinate effectively across time zones and keep deadlines clear.GA date: November CY2026

items.title: Planner: Task History
items.summary: Task History helps keep teams up to date on changes made to a task. View recent activity to see what changed, when it changed, and track progress over time.GA date: October CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Support requirements of tax reform in Brazil in 2027
items.summary: Microsoft plans to introduce additional Globalization Studio capabilities to help support Brazil tax reform requirements, including the new IS tax type, tax assessment capabilities for reformed taxes, expanded fiscal note functionality for additional business scenarios, enhanced tax posting processes, and further updates to CNPJ-related processes. Additional capabilities will continue to be introduced as future phases of Brazil's tax reform are implemented.GA date: November CY2026
